title: Sultan-ı Hünkar 50 ml
body_html:
Designed so that you will feel something is missing on the days you do not wear it. Cognac, the heady character of warm spices, the striking, elegant scent of exotic flowers, bergamot, ylang-ylang, Bulgarian rose and hedione: a luxurious, rich and striking signature scent.

Notes: Cognac, Warm Spices, Exotic Flowers, Bergamot, Ylang-Ylang, Bulgarian Rose, Hedione

title: Vanilla Oud Elixir 50 ml
body_html:
Designed for those who want to feel luxury on their skin and leave an unforgettable impression.

Top: Saffron, Bergamot, Rhubarb

Heart: Oud, Jasmine, Rose, Violet, Cyclamen

Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vetiver

title: Afrodit 50 ml
body_html:
Top: Bergamot, Orange Blossom, Mimosa, Chypre

Heart: White Musk, Opopanax

Base: Vetiver, Patchouli

title: Meditasyon 50 ml
body_html:
Bring your dreams to life in an authentic cabin, with incense and a calm melody. Blended with notes inspired by nature, it is our signature design that you will want to smell again and again, and that gives its wearer peace and calm.

Notes: Bergamot, Citrus, Lavender, Woody Notes, Cedar, Patchouli, Hedione, Guaiac Wood, Musk, Balsamic Notes

title: Afrodizyak Elixir 50 ml
body_html:
Add a romantic touch to your special moments with Afrodizyak Elixir. Our signature design: bewitching, with its allure kept at the highest level.

Notes: Mediterranean Fruits, Chypre, Citrus, Acacia, Vanilla, Sicilian Orange, Blackcurrant, White Musk, Raspberry, Ambroxan

title: High Patchouli 50 ml
body_html:
Our signature design with an intense, bold patchouli character and a strong presence.

Notes: Patchouli

title: Gözyaşı 50 ml
body_html: This design perfume is crafted with a formula of allure and elegance for refined tastes. Graceful and reflecting your inner world, it will accompany your romantic and aesthetic moments.
